text:
kyle: FYI CI perf alert for us-west2 L4 pool after today's deploy. p99 token latency for kv-heavy routes jumped ~2.5x on /generate. Noticed during the post-deploy smoke tests.

sre-bot: [ALERT] perf-regression: cluster=us-west2, hw=L4, route=/generate, metric=p99_token_latency, change=+150% (since 2026-03-15T10:12Z). Auto-tagged possible noisy-neighbor/eviction spike.

jen: I reproduced on staging — same pattern. Profiler shows big increase in KV cache evictions and a kernel fallback on long sequences (1024). Attaching short profiler dump: https://profiler.redwood/reports/1754003209 (flamegraph + timeline).

maria: quick glance at the timeline: kernel_select() is now preferring the "fallback_matmul" path for many layers that used to take the quantized path. KV eviction rate: ~430/s vs 45/s baseline. Something changed the selection heuristic.

dan: leaning toward a regression from last merge. I'm starting a git bisect on the runtime branch now against our perf benchmark suite (perf/kvsuite). Will report back.

alan: notable suspects: the batching-heuristics refactor merged this morning (commit 9c4f2a2). It touched kernel selection thresholds + prefix-sharing estimation. Could be lowering the fast-path threshold for L4 numerics.

dan: bisect update: good=refs/tags/v1.72 (baseline), bad=HEAD. First bad commit found: 9c4f2a2 (batching-heuristics: move kernel selection into scheduler). Reproduces locally with the perf runner.

jen: repro command I used:
```
./tools/perf_run --cluster=us-west2 --hw=L4 --test=kv_eviction --seq=1024 --iters=100
```
Output snippet:
```
KV evictions/sec: 430
p99_token_latency: 612ms (baseline ~240ms)
kernel_path: fallback_matmul selected in 78% of calls
```

maria: profiling snippet (symbols stripped):
```
kernel_select() decisions:
  fast_quantized   -> 10%
  fallback_matmul  -> 78%
  fallback_scalar  -> 12%
KV cache miss ratio increased from 3% -> 28%
```

tim: quick mitigation: I opened CL #2897 that reverts the kernel threshold change in 9c4f2a2 (rollback-only for L4 path) and added a canary rollout to us-west2. Starting canary now (5% of traffic).

jen: canary metrics after 15m: p95/p99 back to baseline on canary nodes, KV eviction down to ~50/s. No increases in error-rate. Looks promising.

kyle: awesome. Treat as rollout blocker until we have a tested fix. Jen/Tim, can you add a regression test that exercises kernel selection decisions under seq=1024+kvs in CI? Also file a follow-up to make selection heuristic hardware-aware (explicit L4/PCIE thresholds).

maria: will add a perf test and an instrumentation flag so we can assert selection ratios in CI. Filed PERF-4203 with the bisect notes and profiler links.

kyle: thanks everyone. Leaving this thread pinned to eng-runtime for post-mortem notes. (reacted with :thumbsup:)
